ApplicationIdQuery.description:
The application the request acts in. Required when the key is bound to applications;
a write may send it in the body instead. Path, query and body must agree.
ApplicationIdQuery.name: application_id

IncludeGlobal.description: On a namespaced read, also return global rows the grant covers.
IncludeGlobal.name: include_global

IncludeUnpublished.description: With `author_id`, the author path (the author's non-removed reviews and media).
IncludeUnpublished.name: include_unpublished

NamespaceType.description: Send with `X-Namespace-ID`, or neither (global). `global` is reserved.
NamespaceType.name: X-Namespace-Type

Token.description: A signed token taken from a URL the API returned.
Token.name: token

NotFound.description: `not_found`: missing, or outside the key's tenant, application or namespace.

reserved_bytes.description: Computed SUM of live pending uploads.

stored_bytes.description: Computed SUM of ready and deleting media.

ApplicationSettingsPut.description: Every field is required; send null to inherit the server default.

max_storage_bytes.description: At most 2^53 - 1, so every SDK language holds it exactly.

entity_id.description: Null when no entity has this key; the summary is then all zeros.

pending_media_deletes.description: Media moved to `deleting`; `cleanup_media` deletes the objects.

remaining.description: Reviews still to redact; call again while above 0.

details.description: Code-specific fields; `docs/errors.md` lists them per code.

message.description: Ends with the fix the caller can apply.

ErrorCode.description: Every code the server sends; `docs/errors.md#<code>` explains each.

HistogramPercent.description: One decimal each; not guaranteed to sum to 100; all zeros when the count is 0.

JsonObject.description: A JSON object chosen by the caller (bounded in size and depth).

url.description:
Null when the caller may not see the media. With `url_unavailable` set, the URL
could not be signed right now; retry the read.

client_upload_id.description: Makes the intent safe to retry; a retry replays the same row.

MediaPolicy.description: The entity's overrides; null inherits the application, then the server default.

author_id.description: The caller's author id; `erased:<hmac>` after erasure.

media_truncated.description: True when more media exist; `GET /reviews/{review_id}/media` returns them all.

media_version.description: Bumps on every media state change.

version.description: Bumps on every content or status change.

author_id.description: Derive it from your own authenticated user, never from client input.

author_metadata.description: Display data such as `display_name`; `avatar_url` must be https.

source_ref.description: An order or booking id. Needs `reviews:attest`; set only at creation.

base_version.description: The review version the edit was made against.

headers.description: Exactly the headers to send. Never contains `Content-Length`; set it yourself.

url.description: Send the bytes here with only `headers`; never the service key.

serviceKey.description: A service key, `ocr_<8 hex>_<secret>`. Never echoed in any response.

info.description:
The contract the Go, PHP and JavaScript SDKs vendor. `docs/spec.md` is the spec of record;
`make openapi-check` keeps this document, `docs/errors.md`, `docs/events.md` and
`docs/sdk-surface.yaml` in step with the server.

Every authenticated request sends `Authorization: Bearer <service key>` and `X-Tenant-ID`.
Every response, errors included, carries `X-Request-ID`. Errors use the envelope in
`components/schemas/Error`; `doc_url` links to the code's anchor in `docs/errors.md`.

New response fields may be added in a minor release: clients ignore fields they do not know.
info.summary: Reviews, ratings and review media for any external entity.
info.title: Octoreview API

get.description: Needs `settings:read` on a global-only or `namespace_wildcard` grant.

200.description: The settings; every field is null until set.

get.summary: Application defaults plus computed storage usage.

put.description: Needs `settings:write` on a global-only or `namespace_wildcard` grant.
put.summary: Replace every settings field; null means "inherit the server default".

get.description: An exact-namespace grant sees only its namespace's rows. Needs `audit:read`.
get.summary: List audit log rows, newest first.

post.description:
Needs `privacy:erase` on a global-only or `namespace_wildcard` grant. Emits
`author.erased`.
post.summary: Redact a batch of the author's reviews; call again while `remaining > 0`.

put.description:
Keyed by `(application_id, entity_type, external_id)` in the request's namespace.
Never reactivates an inactive entity; use `PATCH /entities/{entity_id}` with
`is_active: true`. Needs `entities:write`.

200.description: The entity existed and was updated.

put.summary: Create an entity, or update its metadata and media policy overrides.

get.description:
With `include_global=true` on a namespaced request, a namespaced entity wins over a
global one with the same key.
get.summary: Find one entity by its external key.

post.description:
One summary per requested id, in request order. An unknown id gets a zero-count summary
with `entity_id: null`. Duplicate ids are answered at every position. Needs
`entities:read`. Sends `Cache-Control: private, max-age=60`.
post.summary: Rating summaries for up to 100 entities in one call (a read).

delete.summary: Deactivate the entity (`is_active=false`); nothing is deleted.

get.summary: Get one entity with its rating summary.

patch.summary: Change metadata, media policy overrides or `is_active`.

get.summary: The entity's rating summary. Sends `Cache-Control: private, max-age=60`.

503.description: The database is unreachable (not the error envelope).

get.summary: Readiness probe. Checks the database, never storage.

get.description:
A `public` URL stops working once the media is no longer publicly visible; `author` and
`moderator` URLs stop once it is deleting or deleted (404). Sends
`X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `Content-Security-Policy: sandbox; default-src 'none'`
and `Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy`. On a cloud backend the path answers 404: media `url`
values are presigned store URLs there.

parameters.description: One range (`bytes=0-99`, `bytes=100-`, `bytes=-100`); a multi-range gets the whole body.
parameters.name: Range

get.summary: Local backend only. The target of a local media `url`.

put.description:
Reached through `upload.url`, never built by hand. Requires `Content-Length`; chunked
bodies get 411. CSRF does not apply; the signed token is the credential. On a cloud
backend the path answers 404: `upload.url` is a presigned store URL there.

204.description: The bytes are staged; call complete.

put.summary: Local backend only. The target of a local `upload.url`.

get.description:
Another `status`, `has_pending_revision` or `media_moderation_status` needs
`reviews:moderate`, except the author path: `author_id` with `include_unpublished=true`
returns that author's non-removed reviews of any status. Sends
`Cache-Control: private, max-age=60`.

200.description: A page of reviews with embedded media.

get.summary: List reviews; published only by default.

post.description:
Send `entity_id`, or `entity_type` with `external_id`. `source_ref` and
`is_verified_purchase` need `reviews:attest`. A duplicate
`(entity, author_id[, source_ref])` answers 409 `review_exists` with
`details.review_id`. Under pre-moderation the review starts `pending`.
post.summary: Create a review; the entity is created on first use.

delete.summary: Move the review to `removed` (never a hard delete).

get.description: The author path (`author_id` equal to the review's author, with `include_unpublished=true`) returns author media URLs.
get.summary: Get one review in any status.

patch.description:
Under pre-moderation an edit of a published review becomes a pending revision.
`is_verified_purchase` needs `reviews:attest`; `source_ref` is immutable (409).

post.summary: Hide a published review; its media objects are kept.

200.description: A page of the media, in position order.

get.summary: Page through every non-deleted media item of the review (no embed cap).

post.description:
PUT the bytes to `upload.url` with exactly `upload.headers` and an explicit
`Content-Length` (never chunked, never the service key), then call complete. A retry
with the same `client_upload_id` answers 200 with the same row and a fresh URL for it
(`upload: null` once the row is no longer uploadable). Needs `media:write`.

200.description: A `client_upload_id` replay of an existing row.

201.description: A new pending row and its upload target.

post.summary: Reserve a media slot and get an upload target (intent).

delete.description:
Answers `deleting` when the storage delete failed; `cleanup_media` retries it and the URL
is already null. Refused on a `removed` review (409 `invalid_transition`).
delete.summary: Delete the media object; the row stays as `deleted` (idempotent).

post.summary: Approve pending-moderation media, guarded by the review versions.

post.description:
Retry on 503, 409 `complete_in_progress` and 409 `upload_changed`. A 422
`media_rejected` is final for this row: upload again with a new intent.
post.summary: Validate the uploaded bytes and make the media ready (idempotent).
Reject ready media; the object is kept so the decision can be reversed.
Publish a review, guarded by the versions the moderator saw.
Apply the pending revision, guarded by the versions the moderator saw.
